title: Carter asks CIA director George H.W. Bush for UFO briefing and is refused
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Carter asks CIA director George H.W. Bush for UFO briefing and is refused, about 1976-1977 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he sent for the head of the Central Intelligence Agency to come down to Plains Georgia uh even before he had gone to Washington

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on a podcast about American conspiracies, says that after Jimmy Carter won the presidency in 1976, and before he even went to Washington, he called the head of the CIA, the US spy agency, down to his home town of Plains, Georgia. According to Sheehan, the CIA head at the time, George H.W. Bush, was asked to brief Carter on UFOs and refused. If true, it would mean even an incoming president was kept out of the secret.
